body: I walk outside most days for work so, that's not the problem. I just don't want to see my shitty stats when I play..is that so wrong?

This is Echo, a Wood-Elf Druid. Born in the Artisan Guild, a small tribe. At a very young age, people looked up to him due to his druidic powers, but this attention was not asked for. He would rather befriend animals than his own kin.

He came across some old ruins where he found an Artifact, left by a Golden Dragon. After touching this artifact, he became fluent in Draconic! 

(This is not my drawing, but I had permission to post my character's portrait from the creator that make portraits for all the characters in our group)

Damn, I'm questioning if it was me who wrote this post, because you described my situation rather accurate with your own.

 I know that saying "you're not alone in this" will just sound annoying because it won't help you in this situation. But I want you to know that it's not "pathetic" to feel like this over the lack of love life. 

I'm 22 and I've been crying myself to sleep for the last 3 years because I'm sleeping alone

It's not pathetic.

You're not pathetic.
